parameters.query:
=WITH existing_user AS (
    SELECT id FROM users WHERE mobile = '{{$node["Webhook - Lead Submit"].json["body"]["site_owner_mobile"]}}' LIMIT 1
),
inserted_user AS (
    INSERT INTO users (id, user_type, name, mobile)
    SELECT gen_random_uuid(), 'CUSTOMER', '{{$node["Webhook - Lead Submit"].json["body"]["site_owner_name"]}}', '{{$node["Webhook - Lead Submit"].json["body"]["site_owner_mobile"]}}'
    WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM existing_user)
    RETURNING id
)
SELECT id FROM inserted_user
UNION ALL
SELECT id FROM existing_user;

=INSERT INTO leads (
    retailer_id,
    site_owner_name,
    site_owner_mobile,
    address_line1,
    address_line2,
    town,
    state,
    pincode,
    carpet_area,
    site_type,
    budget_range,
    expected_start_date,
    visit_date,
    visit_time,
    current_status
) VALUES (
    '{{$node["Webhook - Lead Submit"].json["body"]["retailer_id"]}}',
    '{{$node["Webhook - Lead Submit"].json["body"]["site_owner_name"]}}',
    '{{$node["Webhook - Lead Submit"].json["body"]["site_owner_mobile"]}}',
    '{{$node["Webhook - Lead Submit"].json["body"]["address_line1"]}}',
    {{$node["Webhook - Lead Submit"].json["body"]["address_line2"] ? "'" + $node["Webhook - Lead Submit"].json["body"]["address_line2"] + "'" : "NULL"}},
    '{{$node["Webhook - Lead Submit"].json["body"]["town"]}}',
    '{{$node["Webhook - Lead Submit"].json["body"]["state"]}}',
    '{{$node["Webhook - Lead Submit"].json["body"]["pincode"]}}',
    CASE 
        WHEN '{{$node["Webhook - Lead Submit"].json["body"]["carpet_area"]}}' = '< 500 sq ft' THEN 250
        WHEN '{{$node["Webhook - Lead Submit"].json["body"]["carpet_area"]}}' = '500 - 1000 sq ft' THEN 750
        WHEN '{{$node["Webhook - Lead Submit"].json["body"]["carpet_area"]}}' = '1000 - 1500 sq ft' THEN 1250
        WHEN '{{$node["Webhook - Lead Submit"].json["body"]["carpet_area"]}}' = '1500 - 2000 sq ft' THEN 1750
        WHEN '{{$node["Webhook - Lead Submit"].json["body"]["carpet_area"]}}' = '> 2000 sq ft' THEN 2500
        ELSE NULL
    END,
    '{{$node["Webhook - Lead Submit"].json["body"]["site_type"]}}',
    '{{$node["Webhook - Lead Submit"].json["body"]["budget_range"]}}',
    {{$node["Webhook - Lead Submit"].json["body"]["expected_start_date"] ? "'" + $node["Webhook - Lead Submit"].json["body"]["expected_start_date"] + "'" : "NULL"}},
    '{{$node["Webhook - Lead Submit"].json["body"]["visit_date"]}}',
    '{{$node["Webhook - Lead Submit"].json["body"]["visit_time"]}}',
    'CREATED'
) RETURNING lead_id;

=INSERT INTO lead_status_history (
    lead_id,
    old_status,
    new_status,
    remarks
) VALUES (
    '{{$node["Postgres - Insert Lead"].json["lead_id"]}}',
    NULL,
    'CREATED',
    'Initial registration via form'
) RETURNING status_history_id;
